name: New Jazz City chain reads
description: Hosted MCP at https://njc-tx-explain.departmentofjazz.workers.dev/mcp. Free chain reads for agents on Robinhood Chain, Base and Solana (transaction explainer, ERC-8004 control check, open-jobs board). Paid reads return an x402 price and run only with a payment attached; settling that payment moves USDG or USDC from the caller's wallet. No other chain writes. Guard's contributed tool defaults are off until you enable this catalog entry.
saferAlternatives: Use only the free tools (explain_transaction, who_controls_agent, jobs_board); they need no payment or key and change nothing.
Keep the paid read tools on Review: a call with an attached x402 payment moves USDG or USDC from the caller's wallet. Without a payment they only return the price.
